[Publisher](https://doi.org/10.1038/nphys3622). Publisher abstract only. Experiments concern quantised pumping of ultracold fermions in a driven optical superlattice. This supplies no direct validation of vacuum electromagnetic-knot binding or an electron model. Preserve the record and graph edges; do not promote it to the working bibliography or expand its references.

### L21 — Improved original-paper access

[Moffatt original PDF](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/hkm2/PDFs/Moffatt_1969_JFM_35_117.pdf), pp. 118–121, Sections 1–2; p. 119 visually checked. Review now reaches the original Gauss/linking and continuous-vorticity discussion, with the 2017 correction retained. Linking is not a complete knot invariant; conservation depends on the flow and boundary assumptions. This is targeted verification, not a whole-paper or corrected vortex-family audit. L20's final 1958 journal-text audit remains pending.

## Traceability and dispositions

The machine-readable [applicability ledger](applicability.json) records each index path, actual review depth, summary, applicability reason, locations and bibliography key. L24–L31 are added to both [the main register](../README.md) and [BibTeX](../references.bib). They remain outside the frozen recursion seeds. R32 remains in the review/citation ledger without a working-bibliography promotion.

| Impact | Sources | Required handling before using the result | Current disposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| LR3-08 | L24 | Initial persistence conditions, compressible transport and flow regularity | Proposed future topology acceptance refinement |
| LR3-09 | L25 | Map/orientation/normalisation before integer Hopf language | Current domain/amplitude-qualified diagnostics retained |
| LR3-10 | L26/L27 | Scaling hypotheses; optimisation versus physical dynamics | Required model-specification comparison before S5 |
| LR3-11 | L28 | Writhe separated from knot class and closure evidence | Optional future diagnostic; S4-B remains paused |
| LR3-12 | L29 | Complete constraints and perturbation class for energy minima | Required comparison qualification; no confinement claim |
| LR3-13 | L30/L31 | Microscopic fields, dimensions, gauge group and quantisation | Conditional later-model reading; L31 full text pending |
| LR3-14 | R32 | Retain out-of-scope experiments without transferring their evidence | No B0 implementation change |

The audit inspected the current S3-C model/report and S3-D topology conventions. S3-C expressly says it does not compute shear-free flow. S3-D distinguishes physical helicity from integer linking and rejects open curves. No numerical error requiring a change to S1–S4-A has been established by this batch. The new conditions refine proposed future acceptance; no S4-B development or numerical rerun occurred.

## Acquisition and completion status

Authenticated metadata acquisition resumed using a process-local environment variable. The key is sent only as an OpenAlex request header; it is absent from URLs, caches, source files and snapshots. Successful caches remain reusable. Absent-index records remain unresolved while known branches can proceed within the budget; no apparent-relevance pruning is applied. Level-3 requests omit reference lists.

The new cumulative acquisition is separately verifiable in its manifest. The earlier large checkpoint has now been recovered and reconciled; see [the consolidation](CONSOLIDATION.md). Its additional metadata and historical assessments are preserved separately. Nine new paper dispositions plus the targeted L21 upgrade are research progress, not a completed first or second pass over the corpus. Unknown and inaccessible items remain open.
